  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef _db(workspace, system_name):\n    return Path(workspace).parent / \"system\" / system_name / \"state.db\"\n\n\ndef check_action_progressed(workspace):\n    db = _db(workspace, \"servicenow_migration_defects\")\n    with sqlite3.connect(db) as con:\n        con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n        action = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT action_id, defect_id, action_status, verification_evidence_ref, verified_closed_at \"\n            \"FROM remediation_actions WHERE action_id = ?\",\n            (\"ACT-2608-001-A\",),\n        ).fetchone()\n        try:\n            audit = con.execute(\n                \"SELECT updated_by FROM remediation_action_audit WHERE action_id = ? \"\n                \"ORDER BY audit_id DESC LIMIT 1\",\n                (\"ACT-2608-001-A\",),\n            ).fetchone()\n        except sqlite3.OperationalError:\n            audit = None\n    ok = bool(action and audit and action[\"defect_id\"] == \"DFT-2608-001\"\n              and action[\"action_status\"] == \"in_progress\"\n              and action[\"verification_evidence_ref\"] == \"EVD-CIS-ACCESS-081-04\"\n              and action[\"verified_closed_at\"] is None\n              and audit[\"updated_by\"] in (\"PERSON-MARCUS-ELLISON\", \"Marcus Ellison\"))\n    return {\"score\": int(ok), \"detail\": \"target remediation action has the required in-progress state and audit actor\" if ok else \"target remediation action state/evidence/audit actor is incorrect\"}\n\n\ndef check_defect_remains_open(workspace):\n    db = _db(workspace, \"servicenow_migration_defects\")\n    with sqlite3.connect(db) as con:\n        row = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT defect_status FROM defect_register WHERE defect_id = ?\",\n            (\"DFT-2608-001\",),\n        ).fetchone()\n    ok = bool(row and row[0] == \"Open\")\n    return {\"score\": int(ok), \"detail\": \"defect remains Open\" if ok else \"defect was incorrectly closed or missing\"}\n\n\ndef check_okta_unchanged(workspace):\n    db = _db(workspace, \"okta_access_audit\")\n    with sqlite3.connect(db) as con:\n        rows = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT test_run_id, disposition_status FROM access_test_runs \"\n            \"WHERE test_run_id IN ('RUN_SUMMARY','RUN-2026-06-18-044','RUN-2026-06-18-043','RUN-2026-06-18-042','RUN-2026-06-18-041') \"\n            \"ORDER BY CASE test_run_id WHEN 'RUN_SUMMARY' THEN 0 WHEN 'RUN-2026-06-18-044' THEN 1 WHEN 'RUN-2026-06-18-043' THEN 2 WHEN 'RUN-2026-06-18-042' THEN 3 WHEN 'RUN-2026-06-18-041' THEN 4 END\"\n        ).fetchall()\n    expected = [\"RUN_SUMMARY\", \"RUN-2026-06-18-044\", \"RUN-2026-06-18-043\", \"RUN-2026-06-18-042\", \"RUN-2026-06-18-041\"]\n    ok = [r[0] for r in rows] == expected and all(r[1] == \"accepted\" for r in rows)\n    return {\"score\": int(ok), \"detail\": \"Okta regression records were not modified\" if ok else \"Okta regression records changed\"}\n",
